name: HH breakout 04 — fakeout fade reversion, long the down-wick (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: 60-80% of raw crypto breakouts fail — the documented liquidity-grab / stop-hunt where price wicks past a well-watched range extreme to trigger clustered retail stops (the resting liquidity), then reverts into the range. Here we FADE a DOWNSIDE break: enter LONG when range_position is pushed to the LOW extreme (<0.02, fitted) while bb_width is NOT compressed (a range regime, no real vol-expansion fuel — the ceiling keeps us out of genuine squeeze breaks) and adx is LOW (choppy, no trend), betting on snap-back to mid-range. This is the economic INVERSE of the squeeze hypothesis and fires only in the opposite regime (range, low adx), so the two are non-overlapping. Counterparty: the retail breakdown-chaser and their stops, whom larger players deliberately sweep. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the fade's realized reversion (from the extreme-touch bar) does not beat the fee+slippage round-trip on a MAJORITY of symbols per-symbol (not pooled) — or if it only works pre-2024 and the 2025 holdout shows the reversion now happens INTRA-bar before the close entry. High false-signal churn at 15m makes fees the primary killer, so net-of-fees profit factor <1.2 on holdout = dead.
catalyst: down-wick sweep of a range low in a choppy regime
